images.prompt: Camera and composition: top-down flat lay view of a table with three to five related objects neatly arranged, no people. Keep the top fifth of the image as softly blurred or plain background (a title band goes there). An open white electric kettle with a cloudy white scale film on its bottom, a plain glass vinegar bottle, a small unlabeled paper pouch of white powder and a soft yellow sponge neatly arranged on a burgundy table, no people. Color theme: warm burgundy and cream tones with a soft gold accent. Soft matte clay 3D render, rounded chunky shapes, handmade plasticine texture, gentle studio lighting, miniature diorama feel, richer and more saturated colors than pastel, clear contrast, cozy and warm mood. Base colors cream, apricot, mint, sky blue and warm brown, a little deeper than pastel. Add one bright accent color (coral-red, mustard yellow or cobalt blue) on the main person's clothing or the key object. Korean everyday settings. Show only what is described above as the main subject; do not add other large objects that are not described. Everyone shown looks calm and relaxed; nobody is in pain or scared. Do not draw any written words, letters or numbers anywhere in the image; signs, labels, screens and papers stay blank or use simple icons only. No money, banknotes, coins or currency symbols anywhere.
